create_or_update_file.rationale: Creates or updates data in an agent-chosen GitHub repository: `Create or update a single file in a GitHub repository`, with destination fields `owner`, `repo`, `path`, and `branch`, and stored/sent content `content` plus commit `message`. If the repository is public or attacker-readable, this is a public-repository write. Repository visibility is not settled by the text, so SINK is kept.

search_repositories.rationale: `Search for GitHub repositories` can return public repository data whose names/descriptions are attacker-controlled, so UNTRUSTED. The text does not say results are limited to public repositories; with GitHub credentials it may also return private repositories accessible to the user, so SECRET is kept.

create_repository.rationale: Creates a repository in the user's account: `Create a new GitHub repository in your account`. Because `private` is only an option, the tool can create a public repository containing agent-supplied `name` and `description`, making it an attacker-readable write.

get_file_contents.rationale: Reads `the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository`. Public or multi-writer repository file contents can be attacker-authored, so UNTRUSTED. The text does not restrict reads to public repositories; private repositories reachable with the user's credentials may be read, so SECRET is kept.

push_files.rationale: Pushes agent-supplied files to an agent-selected repository and branch: `Push multiple files to a GitHub repository in a single commit`, with `files` containing paths and content and `message` as the commit message. If the selected repository is public or attacker-readable, this is a public-repository write. Repository visibility is not settled, so SINK is kept.

create_issue.rationale: Creates an issue in an agent-chosen repository: `Create a new issue in a GitHub repository`, storing agent-supplied `title` and `body`. Public GitHub issues are attacker-readable, and the text does not limit this to private repositories.

create_pull_request.rationale: Creates a pull request in an agent-chosen repository: `Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository`, with public/stored `title` and `body`. If the repository is public or otherwise attacker-readable this delivers agent-supplied data to that destination; the text does not settle visibility.

fork_repository.rationale: `Fork a GitHub repository to your account or specified organization` changes GitHub state and can create an attacker-readable public fork. The advertised text does not limit the fork destination or visibility, so SINK is kept even though no separate body/content argument is advertised.

create_branch.rationale: Creates an agent-named branch in an agent-chosen repository: `Create a new branch in a GitHub repository`. A branch name written to a public repository is attacker-readable. The text does not limit repositories to private ones, so SINK is kept.

list_commits.rationale: `Get list of commits of a branch in a GitHub repository` returns commit data. Public commit messages, authors, branch names, and metadata can be attacker-authored, so UNTRUSTED. The text does not restrict the repository to public data; private commit history reachable with the user's credentials may be returned, so SECRET is kept.

list_issues.rationale: `List issues in a GitHub repository with filtering options` returns issue titles/bodies/comments metadata that may be authored by public users, so UNTRUSTED. The text does not say the repository must be public; private issues accessible to the user may be returned, so SECRET is kept.

update_issue.rationale: Updates an issue in an agent-chosen repository: `Update an existing issue in a GitHub repository`, including agent-supplied `title`, `body`, labels, assignees, milestone, or state. If the repository/issue is public or attacker-readable, this is a public issue write. The text does not settle visibility.

add_issue_comment.rationale: Adds agent-supplied `body` text to an issue selected by `owner`, `repo`, and `issue_number`: `Add a comment to an existing issue`. Public issue comments are attacker-readable; the text does not restrict this to private destinations.

search_code.rationale: `Search for code across GitHub repositories` can return public code, paths, and repository metadata controlled by attackers, so UNTRUSTED. The text does not say search is limited to public code; authenticated GitHub code search can include private repositories accessible to the user, so SECRET is kept.

search_issues.rationale: `Search for issues and pull requests across GitHub repositories` returns issue/PR text that public users can author, so UNTRUSTED. The text does not limit the search to public repositories; it may include private issues/PRs reachable with the user's credentials, so SECRET is kept.

search_users.rationale: `Search for users on GitHub` returns user profile identifiers/names from GitHub. Public GitHub users can choose their own usernames/profile text, so the result is attacker-controllable. The description does not indicate access to non-public account data, so SECRET is not assigned.

create_pull_request_review.rationale: Creates a review/comment on a PR: `Create a review on a pull request`, with `body` and review `comments` text posted to an agent-selected repository and PR. Public PR reviews are attacker-readable; the text does not restrict this to private repositories.

update_pull_request_branch.rationale: `Update a pull request branch with the latest changes from the base branch` changes a PR branch selected by `owner`, `repo`, and `pull_number`. get_pull_request_comments.rationale: `Get the review comments on a pull request` returns review-comment bodies and authors that external contributors can write in public repositories, so UNTRUSTED. The text does not restrict the repository to public data; private PR comments reachable with credentials may be returned, so SECRET is kept.

get_pull_request_reviews.rationale: `Get the reviews on a pull request` returns review bodies, states, and reviewers that can be authored by public contributors or third parties, so UNTRUSTED.
